ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Abusing Winsat Path Parsing - Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using a path parsing issue in winsat.exe (UACMe 52)

sequences.query: ((process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\system32\\\\winsat\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\ \\\\system32\\\\winsat\\\.exe.*"))
